request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished character design approval board for Rina, the female explorer-artisan of Chamber Clash: The First Workshop. Reference image 1 is ONLY a reference for identity, goggles, chestnut hair, portable workshop and clothing palette. COMPLETELY REDESIGN proportions and rendering: the reference is much too tall and realistic.

Art direction: contemporary cute Japanese fantasy tactical RPG character design, bold expressive anime eyes and playful angular silhouettes reminiscent of Disgaea's exaggerated chibi appeal, but an original explorer-artisan costume. Clean confident tapered ink outlines, graphic cel shading, fresh polished game illustration, restrained texture, not realistic painting. Charming confident young adult heroine represented in super-deformed proportions. STRICTLY 2.25 HEADS TALL including hair, head nearly half the full height; tiny compact torso, very short chunky legs, oversized rounded boots and mitt-like gloves. No long thighs, long torso or slender adult anatomy. Cute bright teal eyes, cheek blush, impish confident smile, chunky chestnut bob with tiny tied tuft, oversized brass goggles perched on head.

Outfit: cropped ivory workshop jacket with teal accents, short tucked amber-rust scarf, dark charcoal compact work shorts over opaque leggings, sturdy brown oversized boots. Simplify seams and small accessories into a few memorable big shapes. Compact rounded-square ivory and dark steel portable workshop backpack, one teal panel and amber latch; distinct and readable from the back, not taller than the torso. Practical modest outfit, no exposed midriff. Empty hands, no weapon. Preserve explorer-artisan identity without the reference's military realism or visual clutter.

Composition: single square cream-white presentation sheet with generous space. Three equally large full-body views of the SAME design, aligned on the same baseline: front at left, back in center, front three-quarter at right. Consistent 2.25-head proportions in EVERY view. Slightly elevated game-camera view revealing tops of head and boots, camera suitable for a 2D arena with movement in all screen directions. Feet planted, arms slightly away from body so silhouette is clear. Above the figures a small neat title RINA. Under the figures three tiny colored swatches ivory, teal and amber and minimal labels FRONT / BACK / THREE-QUARTER. Make the artwork fill most of the sheet, no environment, no large text, no interface, no animations, no alternate outfits, no comparison with the old tall design. Design must remain attractive and legible as a small game character.
